notes.title: 🚀 Raiders Rise – Update v0.5 is here!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone! We’ve just pushed a new update with lots of improvements to the game experience, performance, and stability. Take a look at what’s new:[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🌍 Better Connections & Gameplay[/b][/h3][list][*][p]You can now [b]choose your game region/server[/b] from the Settings menu. This helps improve connection and reduce lag.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated our core tech under the hood (Photon & Quantum) to keep things running fast.[/p][/*][*][p]All 5 current Raiders have received [b]balance tweaks and polish[/b] to make combat feel even better:[/p][list][*][p]🛡️ [b]Jerar[/b][/p][p]Base HP: 750 → 700[/p][p]Basic attack damage: 45 → 50[/p][p]Primary ability hitbox adjusted (more accurate).[/p][p]Bugfix: passive no longer activates twice.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]⚡ [b]Kathy[/b][/p][p]Movement speed: 4.8 → 5.0[/p][p]Secondary ability damage: 90 → 80[/p][p]Improved visual clarity on ultimate.[/p][p]Bugfix: secondary now applies slow correctly.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]🐲 [b]Atabusk[/b][/p][p]Base HP: 1000 → 1100[/p][p]Ultimate cooldown: 40s → 35s[/p][p]New animation for ultimate.[/p][p]Audio tweaks on heavy attacks.[/p][p][/p][p]🎯 [b]Maya[/b][/p][p]Attack range: +0.5[/p][p]Attack speed: 1.2 → 1.0[/p][p]Optimized FX on secondary ability (better performance).[/p][p]Bugfix: projectile no longer passes through small obstacles.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]🔥 [b]Jak[/b][/p][p]Basic attack damage: 60 → 55[/p][p]Base HP: 650 → 700[/p][p]Improved sound feedback for basic attacks.[/p][p]Bugfix: ultimate no longer cancels accidentally.[/p][p]   [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]🖥️ New & Updated Menus[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Several screens have been freshly updated for clarity and style: [/p][list][*][p]Add Friend, Enter Code[/p][/*][*][p]Character Selection[/p][/*][*][p]Reward & Post-Game screens[/p][/*][*][p]Settings[/p][/*][*][p]Pop-ups when you disconnect or quit [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Icons across the game have been touched up for a cleaner look.   [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🐛 Bug Fixes & Polish[/b][/h3][list][*][p]UI now scales correctly on different screen sizes and resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing enemies to get stuck in corners.[/p][/*][*][p]Small fixes across animations and character setups.[/p][/*][*][p]Jak’s dash issue when entering shop is now resolved! [/p][/*][*][p]Jerar’s ultimate whilst dashing issue is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Ultimates showing earlier than expected due to poor connection is also resolved! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for playing Raiders Rise and helping us improve along the way! If you want to continue providing feedback or give V0.5 a go, hop onto our Discord where we host play sessions every Saturday 10pm CET! [/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: ⚙️ Raiders Rise Dev Update - More behind the scenes content!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]Welcome back to another Raiders Rise dev update where we share what’s happening behind the scenes as we work toward release. Let’s jump in![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Player Experience Improvements[/b][/h3][p]We’re making the Friends Flow smoother than ever! Changing your name and managing your friends list (adding or removing players) will soon be more intuitive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/62c54bdbf6ceaedaae8caf0c1822a659d516a062.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/4c7373cd9b0a01b663164df347cc4dbd76a77894.png"][/img][/p][p]Also coming in v0.5: Regional Settings![/p][p]You’ll be able to select your preferred server region in Settings and view your ping. If left on default, the game will auto-select the best region based on your location, improving your matchmaking and overall experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/7faded4a1ffab250ee63c664932dc3e6e8048f00.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧬 Characters & Skins[/b][/h3][p]On the concept side, Lence’s final design is now complete and ready for 3D production![/p][p]We’ve been expanding our skin library too:[/p][list][*][p]Zantetsu is getting our first pirate-themed skin[/p][/*][*][p]Jak and Sky are rocking new steampunk reskins[/p][/*][*][p]Nikky is joining Kathy in the J-pop themed lineup[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/302785f087b4e1cf9c37650396f26c45dc7e085d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/23235e09524281e1cd3e1b8dcf29272fe25f767a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/867f973efe4902c0bad4b020d392d914e1933f47.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/9541c4c663cae6ec7bd11caece63160c936e1841.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5816a93cc0e06d3fb3f013f75cceb087526b83b7.png"][/img][/p][p]In 3D, Maya’s newest skin is finished and will become her base model. Blayze’s model is done, and Korin is ready to hit the stage with a disco-inspired Elvis skin.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/a880e6ceab2a88a8672c7c1837d0c9d777b27311.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/cc85bcf9c63cf8b427f73de613632b06c19c8409.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/b92f80485934244cfbafbe7e82de7790f1fbce0a.png"][/img][/p][p]For Animation, the team have been in full swing:[/p][list][*][p]Zantetsu’s movesets are in progress[/p][/*][*][p]Blayze’s animations are also underway. [/p][/*][*][p]Jerar’s Hell’s Angel skin and Kathy’s J-pop skin are coming to life and we even added keychain physics (tested on Kathy) for some extra flair![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/707f847b197969e83ebd86ad8201029a1aa33bf5.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d7b91fa848e6ba98a44644911d03e0e6ff0fbd4b.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5972bcd51f9ed30311ba057e19573a501e96b80c.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/c66f9488ab07a74234ec10ecdb973bc0cfdb6745.gif"][/img][/p][p]Meanwhile, in the VFX department, River’s teleport effect is done and the first round of Nikky’s VFX is progressing nicely.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/22e15876a88aac0d0affdd9012893a760f25f329.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/2419af72deeec210fc2d4fa4f9636d813798e070.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]🌍 Levels & Environments[/b][/h3][p]While Planet 2 is on hold for now, we’ve kicked off Planet 1.2![/p][p]This shift has given our environment artists a chance to explore more level design. The new desert biome continues to grow, we’ve added ancient ruins powered by crystals, tying directly into the lore of the Raiders and adding new layers of world-building.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d32dbd6352723be123da1f8d3ee4167e8c57c19f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/45bf930574370bc49c98ecccdf1d9b49c26f1d92.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/384e67da99c7df040b5cb10b456ce23fd2bdabf4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/37f3a453ff16cd7a744f69edbfd65ec69d80b96c.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]📣 Join Us![/b][/h3][p]And that’s a wrap for this update![/p][p]If you’d like to help shape the game during development:[/p][p]💠 Wishlist [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3376580/Raiders_Rise/"]Raiders Rise[/url] on Steam[/p][p]💬 Join our Discord for weekly play sessions every [b]Saturday at 10pm CET[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for following along and we’ll see you in the next update![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🛠 Raiders Rise Dev Update – New Skins, Planet 2, and More!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone! We’re back with another update from Raiders Rise, and there’s a lot of exciting stuff to share. Let’s dive in![/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🎯 Battle Pass & Missions Sneak Peak! [/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Battle Pass Preview [/b] You might’ve noticed the Battle Pass tab in-game. We’ve updated it to clearly show that it’s still in progress so players don’t get confused or think it’s broken.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mission Cleanup [/b]Missions got a visual overhaul, this is how they're looking now! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/e23ac772170603fd3f8ce2aa35e611058b11c6b8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5d0aea3997ec4fe5792f8d9b980d422a0f3a63ae.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎨 Raiders[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Latest Raiders!  [/b]Huge thanks to everyone who participated in our polls! Final designs for Blayze and Bebbo are now locked in and looking great.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Skins Incoming[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Snowbird[/b]: Disco won but it was a close call with the Mafia skin! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Korin[/b]: He’s getting down with a disco-themed skin too, thanks to everyone who joined the live stream and helped shape it![/p][/*][*][p][b]Jerar & Kathy[/b]: New models are in. Jerar is sporting a Hell’s Angel aesthetic, and Kathy’s channeling J-pop energy.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Zantetsu[/b]: His final model is complete and ready to animate! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Sky’s Moveset [/b]Animations for [b]Sky[/b] are done. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Monster Animation Updates [/b]We’ve improved the animations for the variations of the bee, big bee, and mortar enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]VFX Passes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]River[/b]: Basic attack, silver bullet, and his sword ultimate now have full VFX. They’re flashy and feel great to use.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Snowbird[/b]: His clones now have distinct visuals to help players tell the real one apart. Better readability = better plays.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Bebbo & Blayze Final Concept[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/cd92cfe2d6630e2e307be3e249db65449a9178ed.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/1c516ef96eb0e8aca8733322bc6ff350801b0eaa.png"][/img][/p][p]Snowbird, Korin, Jerar & Kathy Skins[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/b765e4ef5a0f3c17c58c7545e3b57a7c4dbc501f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/a559de483bc2147d7a797fab7124c8902b001951.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/7def9d3ea239127b8e81b3f25a922bea4ede438d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/1bbfa6745878aa195dbf3c18be76f2b310deddc2.png"][/img][/p][p]Zantetsu Model[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/6baa7b0a86f2d5bdf5a76235a7f8056aa12ec925.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌍 Planet 2! [/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Planet 2 Playtesting Begins [/b]We’ve officially begun playtesting Planet 2! We tried out five brand-new levels and had a blast. There's still plenty of balancing and iteration ahead, but it’s a solid foundation to build on before we move onto adding the visuals to bring the level together.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/2feb34ebb0324ae2ed21b99f89bd6e0d1f3fe633.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🌵Environments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Desert Biome Expands [/b] We’ve added more environmental props to the desert biome including:[/p][list][*][p]Crashed spaceships[/p][/*][*][p]Tech-themed props and structures[/p][/*][*][p]Re-skinned crates, doors, and barriers to fit the new biome.[/p][/*][*][p]New metal material exploration[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tooling Improvements [/b]We built a new tool that lets us make coral formations much faster. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/9f82f5fd31a6700e452a9896ddd196b2e4cf9bf8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5c0d60130128fca045db6f473f1a0dbb13cfb93b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/2e8dbc62fa7c3cdb0fb7ad9d84708b88a1af03ea.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]🧭 Join the Development Journey[/b][/h3][p]That’s a wrap for this update![/p][p] If you want to be part of building our game from the ground up, wishlist Raiders Rise on Steam, and join our Discord to take part in playtests and polls that shape the future of the game.[/p][p]Thanks for being part of the ride! Until next time![/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Raiders Rise Dev Update: New Features and More Art!
notes.content: [p]We’re back with some exciting updates from the world of Raiders Rise. There’s a lot happening, so let’s dive right in! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]⚙️Meta[/b][/h2][p]The Raiders Collection screen is up and accessible from the top menu bar! Here, you’ll be able to browse all available Raiders. Selecting one takes you to their Cosmetics screen, where future skins and visual customizations will appear in the grey placeholder boxes.[/p][p]The Progression tab will allow players to check out their skill tree and if you're curious about their backstory or abilities, the Raider Information button will take you straight to their character info screen.[/p][p]Everything’s functional, though much of it is still placeholder, we’re excited to keep working on it! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/162a68e2861ebe61670f4a5582c46e504ac0bbaf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/49d4171ef30c880736ebd2d76b26c803aacc3d7d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/27e7ba67edfc51763a69e046a5542540642abb98.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]💥Core[/b][/h2][p]We’ve made solid progress on the ultimates for River and Snowbird! [/p][p]River, who normally relies on his gun for basic attacks, now switches things up in his ultimate where he’ll use his blade for a powerful close-range strike.[/p][p]Snowbird’s passive skill is also in: he summons explosive clones that deal damage to monsters before detonating for extra impact. His ultimate creates a blue zone that slows enemies and gives himself an armor buff, making him much harder to take down.[/p][p]And exciting news: Nikky is officially in development! You’ll get a sneak peek at some of his early movesets below! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/71eec95cd3c51ce485389f7226a69f8f896d601f.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5d4423d2064dda1ccab090425ffd3cbab8f0389c.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h2][b]🧑‍🚀Characters [/b][/h2][p]As always, the art side has been packed![/p][p]We’ve been exploring visual directions for our newest Raider, Blayze. [/p][p]Big thanks to everyone who voted in the Zantetsu poll, we’ve locked in his final look. [/p][p]Our concept artists have also been cooking up fresh skins for Maya, Jerar, and Kathy, giving familiar faces some brand-new flair.[/p][p]On the modeling front, both Sky and Atabusk’s models are now complete! Fun fact: the current in-game version of Atabusk will become a skin, while this new model will be his official base look going forward.[/p][p]Enemies are getting some love too, we’ve updated the Mortar and Big Bee with new visual variations to bring more personality to the battlefield.[/p][p]And over in animation, we’re wrapping up the final animations for Korin, Nikky, and River, with Sky’s rig now well underway. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Blayze Concept Exploration[/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/02976c5c5b431ccb508c05f206b2eb749c7a175a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Zantetsu Concept[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/bcaa6e8d037cdbc0c9ae6343882c8643f3cb1d72.png"][/img][b]Jerar Skin Concept[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/7962f57d3b50f099cf6bfdf39e50a5ccb82eabe2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Atabusk Base Model[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/2917310f4e34c1697ae456cefe77250d2ac4442d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Sky Rig[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5d44f483e34c3b707f136294361ba1b0141a8aee.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🌍Environment[/b][/h2][p]Last but not least, the Environments team has been hard at work expanding our desert biome, a once-submerged landscape now dried out and teeming with relics of the past.[/p][p]We’ve added buried boats, sea creatures remains, weathered buildings, and market stalls to give the area a sense of depth.[/p][p]We’ve also wrapped up polishing on the shop area, below you’ll see a closer look at some of the shop props. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/53011634495fb21ce3daa986b2b1120c1ffc19f6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/1277c9fe7f7f8c50691d581df523e80bc255e5ff.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d9fab477653845fbc0efa596bea2fea76a200b77.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]🎯That’s a wrap![/b][/h2][p]Thanks for joining us on another update! [/p][p]If you want to help shape this game while it’s still in development, don’t forget to wishlist Raiders Rise on Steam and join us on Discord for playsessions every Monday 5pm CET. [/p][p] [/p][p]See you next time![/p][p]   [/p]

notes.title: 🚨Raiders Rise Dev Update - Supercell Announcement & What’s New!
notes.content: [p]We’re back with another exciting update and this one’s a big one. These past few weeks have been packed, both in and out of the game, and we’re thrilled to finally share what’s been going on.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🎉 Supercell TimeOut Tournament[/b][/h3][p]We were honored to be invited to Supercell’s annual TimeOut event, where we held a live Raiders Rise tournament in Helsinki![/p][p]It was an incredible experience to connect with fellow developers, exchange stories about the wild ride that is game development, and feel part of a community that truly understands the journey.[/p][p]And a personal highlight? Mike Morhaime - yes, The former CEO of Blizzard - played our game! 😱[/p][p]Huge thanks to the team at Supercell for the invite and for putting together such a fantastic event. We're still buzzing![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d7698057509e2349a9c480c92e84ac2e1b639bcc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/44eb76dc4ae244fc9b544258dcdc4e7c66b9ebec.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But just because we hit this milestone doesn’t mean we’re slowing down - here’s what’s been cooking in development while the event was happening:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]💥Core [/b][/h3][list][*][p]Snowbird & River are now in the testing phase, with ongoing balancing and visual implementation.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The Wall and Maze levels are also now in testing - visuals are shaping up nicely.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Our design team is hard at work drafting documentation for Characters 11 to 20! These are now in review and will be iterated on in the upcoming weeks.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/b36cbfb72bd6ad5111e36d19161a6ba768cd7ecb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/a6f928f309a716a3d37744d17233d7ade00fa644.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧑‍🚀Characters[/b][/h3][p]Our character team continues to push forward with new additions and refinements:[/p][list][*][p]Finalized concept for Character 10: Sky[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]First concept art drafts for Character 11: Zantetsu[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New base concepts for both Atabusk and Maya[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Modeling is now complete for Snowbird[/p][/*][*][p]Big Bee enemy variants[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Animation progress for River and Nikky[/p][/*][*][p]Ongoing animation iteration for Korin, we’re still trying to get a feel for this character’s movement.[/p][/*][/list][p][img notes.title: 🚨 Sprint 7 Update
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]Welcome back to another Raiders Rise dev update - and a big thanks to all of you following our development journey. We’ve got a packed one this sprint, so let’s dive right in:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]⚙️ Meta[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Top Menu Bar Rework -[/b] Now fully gamepad-ready for smoother navigation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle Pass & Missions - [/b]Work continues on these progression systems.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lobby, Friends & Matchmaking UX - [/b]We’ve been squashing bugs and making steady improvements to ensure everything feels intuitive and responsive.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d9e0038385d32b779a2798c4da3da4c0232dc2ec.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/cea2ac71f23fa1b20b00f74bdc1bb7cfe28c8cf8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/03c4676efa2ad9e943311bc4c1b54fc13e1b2d02.png"][/img][/p][p][b]💥 Core Gameplay[/b][/p][p]Big steps forward with our next two playable characters: Snowbird and River![/p][p][b]Snowbird[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Basic - [/b]Snowbird basic attack is implemented and feels great![/p][/*][*][p][b]Ultimate -[/b] His ultimate slows nearby enemies and grants a personal shield.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skill -[/b] Snowbird creates ice clones to confuse and distract enemies - perfect for sneaking past them! [/p][/*][/list][p][b]River[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Basic - [/b]Implemented, with a twist: his last bullet bounces around the level before reloading![/p][/*][*][p][b]Ultimate - [/b]Placeholder implemented, when we do the final pass you’ll see he equips his sword when the ultimate is activated. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level Expansion[/b][/p][p]Early versions of Level 1 for both Planet 2 and Planet 3 are now roughed out and ready for internal testing. The world is expanding![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/86c56851d88e67de3bddf1825ce115684fe7c8b0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/b29007527203ebd838b7621ef349f2a1142d91bc.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🧑‍🚀 Characters [/b][/p][p]The character team has been hard at work this sprint:[/p][list][*][p][b]Snowbird and River - [/b]models are nearly complete and ready for integration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Korin[/b] [b]-[/b] a melee-centric character, is getting special treatment with new workflow tests to support his unique combat style.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nikky - [/b]To speed things up without sacrificing quality, we’re transferring base animations from River to Nikky.[/p][/*][*][p][b]River - [/b] VFX moodboarding is underway, giving us a glimpse at the visual direction Alex is taking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sky - [/b]our 10th character is in early concepting![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/7fa7933cf99766cab66ae91310747af37b8df81a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/ac2fdc53ef6216f9faa2e873363e0e137aaad0cd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/ea63f13c8627530393d1001532ce8922a25b5eb4.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5a983c74142b34d6511f544f7a4e5620189963d5.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/fee2aeeed3332359da7c96c8c9b580562af3e40b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/c03aca200b37c99179ea61c37f522b96cf032fe7.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]🌍 [b]Environment Art[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Wall & Maze Levels - [/b]The last two levels of planet 1 are almost ready for internal testing! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Planet 1 Polishing - [/b]Level polish continues across the board, helping bring a more lived-in, reactive feel to each environment.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/e7aa2fb08c05d1d3ca0b9eabd4c40b033405d3fb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/b499a0f6f19d5a251cc82e4050f9be5706f358f3.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🎯That’s a Wrap![/b][/p][p]Thanks for checking out our latest sprint update! Your support, feedback, and playtesting means the world to us as it’s shaping Raiders Rise into something truly special.[/p][p]If you haven’t already:  ➡️ Wishlist Raiders Rise on Steam  ➡️ Follow us for future updates  ➡️ Join our Discord to playtest and share your feedback![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time!  - The Raiders Rise Team[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Sprint 6 Update
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]Welcome back to another Raiders Rise dev update and this one’s a big one.[/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that we hit our milestone for Build 0.3! A massive shoutout to the entire team for the incredible push to make it happen. Let’s jump into what’s new:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]⚙️ Meta[/h2][list][*][p][b]Lobby Finalized[/b] – The new lobby layout is in and locked (for now).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Friends System Improved[/b] – Friends are now grouped into Online and Offline for clearer visibility.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Matchmaking Debug Tools[/b] – Backend updates allow us to fix matchmaking issues during play sessions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fight Flow UI[/b] – Our combat flow now has sleek new UI mockups![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5a7663fbf679eb0b8d434fe1a3becbf3fedac901.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/e0bd0881b930aac406e8e5b0534087ee4ffa95c2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/c2d7c2b3d11203e04abdd0cf1f591d9972bb73f1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/860bc7ea0acedd305835bd5891d7dddd2c0cc4e3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]💥 Core Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p][b]Health Bar Update[/b] – Health bars now clearly show how your HP stacks up against others.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skill Icons & Cooldowns[/b] – Passive abilities now show cooldowns, plus we’ve refreshed passive icons and skill upgrade headers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Re-Deploy Damage[/b] – You can now damage enemies on landing when re-deploying.[/p][/*][*][p][b]In-Game Emojis[/b] – New emoji set was added! We’ve trimmed down the slots to reduce visual clutter and streamline usage.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/6e8460e9a605c8890d8c23c863419dbd53356bb9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🧑‍🚀 Characters & VFX[/h2][list][*][p][b]Character Portraits[/b] – Full-body portraits and icons for our first 5 characters have been added to the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Concept Art[/b] – We made progress on the adorable (and dangerous) Summoner enemy, and supported icon work for consumables.[/p][/*][*][p][b]3D Art[/b] – Jak’s model is shaping up nicely, and Nikky’s blockout is already in the works![/p][/*][*][p][b]Animations[/b] – Jak is fully animated and milestone-ready! Plus, mining animations got a polish pass across several characters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]VFX Update[/b] – Say hello to the explosive Kamikaze enemy. You’ll know them when you see them.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/7ccc2b0bc61ef586372819a31682ec60718e4f4c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/e29692aaed19289e37366c56017248ebf7878c5c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/72c21ea93a2d1c80fa8ac8d87d457e12b94c01d8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5da67627e6f88bc46b41217b73193cde0500ea54.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/13adc87d435605347ac07277acaf9d9a2cf272b2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/ae7b52e54e8193adb6017593c18c35ee92bdf08e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🌍 Environments[/h2][p]All milestone levels are now in-game! Here are some standout improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Bus elements[/p][/*][*][p]Sliding & drop-down doors[/p][/*][*][p]Vending machines (yes, they have sad faces when you can’t interact and happy ones when you can - our favorite detail!)[/p][/*][*][p]Crates galore – regular, military, destructible, energy[/p][/*][*][p]Exterior of the shop[/p][/*][*][p] Crystals[/p][/*][/list][p]Our world’s coming to life in big ways, and these environmental updates make each match feel that much richer.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/f6a5fae6e48a61221c3df59587e95c7bcf35d58f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/21b3a88a7317f4e9074cbd97ae883020443f0863.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/1bf3b9899b0c15fb2b034b253a8e10a29df75da7.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/c1329a1cbddb88dc224a76fd3a40b8a36b7eac7e.gif"][/img][/p][h2]🎯 That’s a Wrap![/h2][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading and for being part of this journey. If you’re enjoying the ride so far, don’t forget to:[/p][p]➡️ [b]Wishlist Raiders Rise[/b][/p][p]➡️ [b]Follow us for more updates[/b][/p][p]➡️ [b]Join the playsessions in our Discord![/b][/p][p][/p][p]More fun, chaos, and surprises are on the way. See you in the arena![/p][p][/p][p][i]– The Raiders Rise Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🚀 Sprint 4 Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Raiders Rise – Sprint 4 Dev Update[/b][/h1][p]Hi everyone, welcome back to another sprint update for [b]Raiders Rise[/b]! Every two weeks we share our progress, and this sprint was packed with big steps across systems, characters, and levels. Let’s dive into the highlights:[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🧠 Meta & Core Systems[/h2][p][b]Mission Progression Revamp[/b] Backend and frontend improvements made to mission progression, plus internal testing of the [i]Battle Pass prototype[/i]. [b]Reconnection System[/b] First version is in! If a player disconnects, a [i]bot temporarily takes control[/i] until they return - making matches smoother even with connection drops. [b]Victory Screen Iteration[/b] A working version is in place, but we’re still figuring out how to properly display characters and their skins without visual overlap. One proposed fix is cropping each character's screen space to avoid clutter. [b]Duo Chests[/b] These new chests [i]require two players to open[/i] - either teammates or opponents. Strategic and cooperative! [b]Expanded Emotes[/b] 9 total slots: 5 for team, 4 for public emotes Fully functional with controllers Cancel input added (Control scheme still being polished)[/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45360127/8fbd8bee2f99b8483739fe2229c4bddbb451a713.gif"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45360127/86f4c4443b4bc37292b1c70df1e199fbeebe800c.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45360127/e4db4d4ec5ff03dc55e37ab39d2cbc346e7db827.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🧑‍🚀 Characters & Creatures[/h2][p][b]Jak[/b] Receiving new weapon options, including a shotgun. Her updated model is in blockout and uses a [i]liquid shader[/i] for more dynamic visuals. [b]Nikky[/b] Our new [i]electric trap specialist[/i] is in early development. Their gameplay is focused on area control and surprise traps. [b]Maya[/b] Preliminary model and weapon are finalized and looking slick. Animation improvements are also underway. [b]Bee Enemies[/b] We’ve created [i]three evolution stages[/i] for this new enemy type - they’re deadly [b]and[/b] cute. [b]Animation Work[/b] Final tweaks for [i]Atabusk[/i] Character-specific polish for [i]Jerar[/i] and [i]Maya[/i][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45360127/02878895a189a971e2ec6038e7f1bdcfd56f3128.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45360127/801873b989a12bd96e4f3ce5ecac039d1d55b49e.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45360127/ead0b4f8eb2e659d1af40ac271916715934ee917.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🌍 Levels, Props & Biomes[/h2][p][b]Planet 1 - Level 2[/b] Playable. We’re working on [i]signs, city props[/i], and [i]biome 2 assets[/i]. [b]Destructible Elements[/b] We prototyped [i]breakable barriers[/i], tested in a sandbox scenario. Players will soon get some nice visual feedback on these destructable elements! [b]New Door Mechanics[/b] Multiple door types in testing - including [i]drop-down doors[/i] with improved clarity and performance.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45360127/efab786ff03e7ba86236102fb2e16336eb8f8423.jpg"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45360127/4b9d98804b6f3a67bc1588c352d12c3e301013a7.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45360127/f32bd898e1ee8077af3169dbd0d7a2845211f6ec.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🧪 Playtests & Community[/h2][p][b]Weekly playtests[/b] happen [u]every Monday at 17:00 CET[/u] – open to everyone via our Discord! Come test the latest builds, give feedback, and help us shape the game together. [b]📅 Join us →[/b] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3376580/partnerevents/edit/YOUR_DISCORD_LINK_HERE"]Discord Invite[/url] [b]🎮 Wishlist the game →[/b] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3376580/partnerevents/edit/YOUR_STEAM_LINK_HERE"]Steam Page[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]💬 Final Words[/h2][p]That’s it for Sprint 4! Massive shoutout to the team for the amazing work across all departments - from gameplay systems and character design to animation and level art. We’ll be back in two weeks with even more. Thanks for following us on this journey. 💜[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Raiders Rise – Sprint Update #2
notes.content: [h2]🎮 Core Features & Systems[/h2][h3]✅ Battle Pass Fully Integrated[/h3][p]The Battle Pass UI is up and running! Players can now:   View milestones  Track progression  Claim rewardsAll fully connected to our backend systems via Metaplay. Next sprint, we'll finalize the AT2 and polish the experience even further. [/p][p][/p][h3]🧪 Major Stabilization & Versioning Pass[/h3][p]We've spent a good chunk of this sprint making sure the Quantum version of the game is stable and ready for external playtests. Here’s how:   We created a dedicated release branch ([b]v0.1[/b]) for bug fixing only—no new features, no distractions.  Meanwhile, all ongoing feature work continues in [b]main[/b], including new characters, animations, and VFX.This setup lets us iterate fast without breaking everything. Expect more clean versions like this in the future!  [/p][p][/p][h2]🧝‍♂️ Characters & Animation[/h2][h3]✨ New Characters Incoming![/h3][p]   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/235c14440fd939a5552b51b81e630b45f0c80bbe.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/9e2d70cb4da5880fbb8ccae78a87b578d6e9e77d.png"][/img][b]Korin [/b]is in progress and already in blocking stage.  A brand-new [b]tank[/b] is in the works, inspired by the iconic albino gorilla from Barcelona Zoo (yes, really).[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/c7f419cdd062e176cc4773b8aeecd799b42929a8.png"][/img][b]Atabusk[/b] is fully modeled and now animated with a strong, aggressive idle pose. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐧 The Penguin is Alive![/b][/h3][p]The Penguin character is now fully animated with:   Idle, attack, jump, and movement loops[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/8e865d0757a4326c7ea93a3657580c5492a88832.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/78c661445dfdce4faa08101efd210d6e9b0167e2.gif"][/img]Plus a hilarious [b]inflate-and-pop ultimate[/b] in the works. It’s one of our most expressive characters so far! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/9367afc65efec9042ef52a3cf7ecab153fab6e07.gif"][/img] [/p][h2]💥 VFX & Combat Polish[/h2][p][b]Maya’s[/b] attack and ultimate animations are looking slick with some flashy new VFX from Alex. We're pushing for every character to feel distinct and powerful in battle.  [/p][p][/p][h2]🏜 Environment & Tools[/h2][h3]🌵 Desert Biome Progress[/h3][p]We’re working hard to lock down the visual style of the desert biome. Highlights:   Unique materials tied to the desert’s lore[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/13c672f9f0658f4ec0f05869e5aff169ea012124.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/0a34b77764c8a302d581b7d8a84d048f4e282036.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/0a8b797d5f53e2ef49de9bcb6b18a3d742d54cc3.png"][/img] Level dressing tools to speed up iteration  Deeper, more layered layout designs [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/a73ea1f97340e613e845f35e968b3b2db150bfd8.png"][/img]In-world animated signs and visual storytelling elements[/p][p][/p][h3]📢 In-World Advertising Concepts[/h3][p] We’re also exploring how in-world signage and ads can tell stories and build immersion. These aren't just decoration—they tie into the lore and factions. [/p]

notes.title: Raiders Rise Update!
notes.content: [h1]📢 Game Development Updates[/h1][p] [/p][h2]🎯 Missions System (Work in Progress!)[/h2][p]One of the [b]biggest new features[/b] we started integrating is the Missions System. The goal is to track in-game achievements, like collecting resources or completing certain challenges.   Right now, we’re setting up the backend so that the game correctly registers and saves progress.   This is a [b]major step[/b] toward adding more structured gameplay goals and keeping things engaging for players.  [/p][p][/p][h2]🛍️ UI Overhaul & Store Improvements[/h2][p]The UI team made [b]great progress[/b] in reworking the in-game store.   We’re moving toward a [i]cleaner, more intuitive layout[/i], making it easier for players to browse, purchase, and customize their raiders.    A new upgrade system design was also introduced, where upgrades are now represented as “[b]chips[/b].”   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5ce67d209b70cf6c8bccdb4e37224912ca68932f.jpg"][/img]This makes the system more thematic and visually appealing, while also making it easier for players to understand.   We’re even toying with fun ways players might refer to it—like calling it the [i]chip shop[/i]!  [/p][p][/p][h2]🕹️ Gameplay & Feature Updates[/h2][p][b]Scaling Adjustments:[/b]   We fixed a lot of proportional issues in the game world, so objects, characters, and UI elements are more consistent in size and readability.  [b]New Cosmetics & Customization Menus:[/b]   A first version of the character customization system is ready!   Players will be able to change [i]skins, emotes, and more[/i].  [b]Emojis System:[/b]   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/dc82089dd11a9fbd80e00b752a1e5960f819d42c.jpg"][/img]We’ve started implementing an [b]emoji communication system[/b] for players to use in-game.   These emojis can be:  Text-based   Animated   Include sound effects   (Yes, the poop emoji [i]does[/i] have a sound effect. Priorities.)  [/p][p][/p][h2]🧙 Character & Art Updates[/h2][p][b]New Characters in Production:[/b]   Character design has been on fire this sprint!   Several new characters are at different stages of development:   [b]River[/b] design is approved!   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/495f40f30939a4775be0c06b2cde5c884deee368.jpg"][/img] A powerful [i]old-lady healer[/i] is in progress—she’s not just wise, she’s a healer.   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d6341ca4b2059544b9c62e0684175a9426bd8deb.png"][/img] [b]Atabusk[/b] hi poly model is finally finished!   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/eb58d6b076c27c88d142b0fdc093f1dda3bc76fe.jpg"][/img] New hi poly models, rigs and animations are coming in fast, making the roster more diverse and exciting.   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/ded49eace26ada32a0d5da301ac96bc5714df823.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/3b7b568a7d0ef1e60695a6eff6ea76049f0f0ed7.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/00ad1bfacb4b78da9e6ada0e2d581416c0810ce9.gif"][/img] [/p][p][/p][h2]🌵 Environment & Visual Enhancements[/h2][p]The art team has been fine-tuning the environmental design to create a more distinct visual identity for the game.   Some key updates include:   A new [b]shading technique[/b] that adds a subtle texture to objects, making everything feel more hand-painted instead of flat.   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5a2e5186272aa02f9e713ddbc69fe98ed881d915.gif"][/img] Improvements to [b]desert environments[/b], helping us define the final visual style of the game’s world.   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/60ad856fdde781dc760858ae7cedcb3a1838f214.png"][/img] [b]Level design sketches[/b] are being finalized, giving clearer direction for upcoming environments.   [/p]
